title: Study firstmate's work handling as a validated study
summary: Read as a study job: model how firstmate (pinned from the configured repo, kunchenguid/firstmate) handles work, as cited typed records plus a work-handling model that the athena-cap-study validator accepts. It is the "study firstmate's work handling" first use of the capability named in BRIEF.md; no Athena behavior changes.

defaults_applied.how: Every claim cites the pinned source; numbers are measured or labeled as estimates.
Recovered 'M1' and the scope from BRIEF.md and docs/design/study-capability-m1.md.
Quotes from firstmate are public repo text only; no secrets or personal data.
An independent verifier reruns validation and checks citations against the pin.

assumptions: The study is stored under studies/firstmate-work-handling/ as JSON records; the exact layout follows the athena-cap-study schemas and may differ.
'M1' means the first milestone in BRIEF.md (one mechanism, work handling, on firstmate), not a code milestone.
Scope is firstmate only; Hermes and Athena itself are separate studies.
I did not read pinned-source/ or the record schemas in crates/athena-cap-study, so the file names are guesses.

acceptance_criteria.text: A study directory (assumed studies/firstmate-work-handling/) holds typed records: pin (resolved SHA), claims, rationale cards, and a work-handling model, matching the study.*/1 schemas in docs/design/study-capability-m1.md.
Every claim about firstmate cites a file and line range (or run) in pinned-source/ with a quote; numbers are measured or labeled as estimates.
The model covers how work enters, is assigned to the crew, progresses, is reviewed, and finishes or fails, with guards and each element evidenced.
Any divergence between what firstmate's docs say and what it does is recorded as a contradicts-linked finding, and enforcement of each rule is marked as mechanism or prose-only.
Run cargo test --locked and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings; both pass, and the study validation (every section 5.4 rule) reports pass with no offending ids.

out_of_scope: Studying Hermes Agent or Athena itself
Changing the study capability crate or schemas
departures: Higher cost and time than the reference: a study must read a whole external repo and write cited records, and the verifier must recheck citations.
